task_instance: Arm away-mode for an overnight autonomy grant ('full autonomy till morning, keep CI green and merge the safe ones, decide for me, we talk at 8am') over a small sample inventory of two PRs and one flaky nightly job: restate the grant, create the durable away log, and arm the watch timer that drives the tick loop.
blocker_detail: The core deliverable is autonomous unattended operation while the user is away, driven by a watch timer that fires the skill's recurring tick prompt back into this agent session. The runtime grants only file/shell/dev-server/browser/log/converse abilities and no scheduled-prompt or future-wakeup mechanism. There is no crontab or at command; the only system scheduler present (systemctl) runs at machine level and cannot inject a prompt into this agent session, and would require changes outside the work directory. The skill's own timer reference requires the host's scheduled-prompt tooling on this platform (its cron-style scheduled-task tools); those are host session-management tools that are both outside the runtime's granted abilities and explicitly forbidden by the safety rules. Per the skill's own timer reference, a host without scheduled prompts 'cannot promise future wakeups', so the overnight monitoring loop that is the point of the skill cannot run. The non-timer parts (grant restatement, durable away log with Grant/Items/Trail/Decided/Held sections, and the decide-or-hold classification) were produced and verified as files, but they do not constitute the autonomous operation the skill exists to deliver.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/timer.md from the skill repo. Created work dir and sample scenario: sample_project/inventory.md (two PRs + one flaky nightly job) and a goal grant. Produced the durable away log at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r244/away_log.md (41 lines, with Grant/Items/Trail/Decided/Held/Corrections sections per the skill). Scheduling capability probe: 'command -v crontab at' -> not found; only systemctl present; 'crontab -l' -> command not found. No tool in this runtime can schedule or inject the recurring '/away-mode tick' prompt into the session, so the watch timer cannot be armed and the autonomous tick loop cannot run. Files produced: away_log.md, sample_project/inventory.md, result.json.
